# Tiered Vocabulary Support Sheet

Subject: Differentiation and Special Education Support
Grade band: 3-5
Resource type: Vocabulary Scaffold
NYS framework label: NYS Learning Standards with UDL-aligned access supports

## Short Description
A planning sheet for choosing must-know, helpful, and extension words before a lesson.

## Alignment Note
Supports language access, vocabulary planning, and inclusive instruction.

## Classroom Use Case
Use before content lessons so students have access to key terms without lowering rigor.

## Preview Content
- Must-know words
- Student-friendly meaning
- Picture, gesture, or example

## Teacher Notes
This original StandardCraft resource is intended to support planning and classroom use. It is not issued by NYSED and does not replace district curriculum, local requirements, or teacher professional judgment.
